name: Autobahn Police Simulator 4
storyline:
The Autobahn is calling.

Join the German police on the Autobahn and keep the roads safe in a fully drivable open world: unrestricted highways, winding country roads and lively towns. In Autobahn Police Simulator 4 you'll experience police duty in more depth than ever before. Conduct traffic stops, secure accident scenes and give chase when a suspect makes a run for it.

Patrol a fully drivable open world in a range of police vehicles, from the standard patrol car to an unmarked unit. Highways with rest stops and gas stations meet industrial zones, residential neighborhoods and small towns nestled between forests and mountains.

The radio calls, and you decide how to respond. Whether it's a routine stop, accident assistance or a high-speed pursuit with lights and sirens: every call brings new challenges. Act by the book and succeed on duty to earn reputation, climb the ranks and unlock new vehicles, equipment and police stations.
summary: Experience daily police duty on Germany's Autobahn like never before and keep the peace in a living open world. From traffic stops to high-speed pursuits: every call is yours to answer.
